businessDifference.conflictSummary: The old 80/17/3 policy made 20-60 second waits occur 17 percent of the time and 90-180 second waits occur 3 percent of the time; Xiuluo and Wubei also owned duplicate implementations.
businessDifference.userDecision: Use one shared seven-band policy: 70 percent 2-6s, 20 percent 6-12s, 7 percent 12-25s, 2 percent 25-45s, 0.7 percent 45-75s, 0.25 percent 75-140s, and 0.05 percent 140-180s.

implementationStatus: Both tasks call HumanizedInterRoundRest only after a successful completed round when progress.shouldStartNextRound() is true. The shared policy samples the approved inclusive millisecond ranges and sleeps in stop-aware slices of at most 1000ms without physical input.
